2. **1895**: Source D3S2 states 'The house was built in 1895' referring to the David H. Jones House in Spanish Fork, Utah (contradicting D1S4 regarding the same location, but both are explicitly cited as facts in the text).
3. **1874**: Source D4S3 states the David Jones House in Maryville, Tennessee 'was built in 1874'.

Per instructions to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers, all three dates are retained as they correspond to different houses (or conflicting claims for the same house) found in the source text. The audit labels correctly identify C2 (1874) as a different argument (different location) while C0 and C1 represent conflicting claims for the Spanish Fork house.
